keppyWorld.intro: Choose your mascot. Explore, solve quests and open new places together.
keppyWorld.emptyRanking: Complete a quest to join the leaderboard.
keppyWorld.questHelp: Approach a marker on the map and press Enter to claim a quest.
keppyWorld.signInDescription: Sign in to save your character and join the shared world.
keppyWorld.loadError: The world is unavailable. Please try again.
keppyWorld.requestFailed: Could not complete the action. Please try again.
keppyWorld.connectionError: Connection lost or the world is full. Try reconnecting.
keppyWorld.expired: This quest has ended. Choose another one in the world.
keppyWorld.tryAgain: Not quite. You can retry; your daily allowance is unchanged.
keppyWorld.gateLimit: Use AND, OR, XOR, NOT; at most {{count}} gates.
keppyWorld.programHelp: Commands: move, left, right, repeat N { … }. Limit: {{count}} commands. Collect diamonds and reach the flag.
